description: This Java class defines a Cart entity for an e-commerce application, representing a shopping cart with properties like cart ID, merchant store ID, customer ID, currency, status, timestamps, and associated cart items. It includes methods for adding, updating, and removing items, as well as lifecycle hooks for persistence events.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Entity class representing a shopping cart, with properties for cart identification, customer, merchant store, currency, status, timestamps, and associated cart items. Provides business logic for managing cart items and lifecycle hooks for persistence.

methods.name: Cart
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new cart with merchant store, customer, and currency, generating a new UUID and setting default status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: JPA lifecycle callback method that sets creation and update timestamps and default ID/status before persisting.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: JPA lifecycle callback method that updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp before updating.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart or increments its quantity if already present.

methods.name: setItemQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a specific product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by product ID.
